description: Per SU(3)_R highest-weight sector with graviton classes: number of graviton classes (grav, products of u_n, v_n, w_n modulo Q-exact, full matrices; taken from the collaboration's complete hw scans) and number of Coulomb-type ones (coulomb = rank of the graviton hw vectors evaluated on Cartan-valued letters, where Q-exact operators vanish); noncoulomb = grav - coulomb. Files: noncoulomb_{su3,su4,so5,so7,sp3,so11,sp5}.jsonl
code: fortuity.hwcoh.noncoulomb (cartan_rank / sector_counts: GravitonAlgebra.hw_blocks, rows_from_blocks, evalg.Frame(cartan=True)); first computed by code/fortuity/hwcoh/noncoulomb.py at 76582d9
commit: 76582d9 (computation); 4f20e8a (code/ module that reproduces every file identically, 2026-10-01)
conventions: D-006 (fortuity.bmn.words); sector (2J; q1,q2,q3), q_I = R_I + J, j = 2 sum q; graviton generators n <= 3 (SU(3)), 4 (SU(4)), 8 (SO(5), SO(7), Sp(3)) as in the source scans
command: cd code; python -m fortuity.hwcoh.noncoulomb SU 3 3 OUT ../data/su3/bmn_hw_cohomology_j30.json; ... SU 4 4 OUT ../data/su4/bmn_hw_cohomology_j28.json ../data/su4/bmn_hw_cohomology_j30.json; ... SO_odd 2 8 OUT ../data/so5/bmn_hw_cohomology_j28.json; ... SO_odd 3 8 OUT ../data/g2/so7_hw_cohomology_j20.jsonl ../data/g2/so7_hw_cohomology_j22_j24.jsonl ../data/g2/so7_hw_cohomology_j26.jsonl; ... Sp 3 8 OUT ../data/g2/usp6_hw_cohomology_j20_j24.jsonl; ... SO_odd 5 12 OUT ../data/so_sp/so11_hw_cohomology_j26.jsonl; ... Sp 5 12 OUT ../data/so_sp/usp10_hw_cohomology_j26.jsonl
sources: grav from data/su3/bmn_hw_cohomology_j30.json (R-007), data/su4/bmn_hw_cohomology_j28.json and _j30.json (R-008, R-014), data/so5/bmn_hw_cohomology_j28.json (R-012), data/g2/so7_hw_cohomology_j20.jsonl, _j22_j24.jsonl, _j26.jsonl and usp6_hw_cohomology_j20_j24.jsonl (R-013)
checked: validated on the known cases (SU(3) (3;4,4,4): 1 graviton, 0 Coulomb, R-002; SU(3) (0;4,2,0): 1 of 1; SO(7)/Sp(3) (2;6,3,3): 21/20 vs 20/20, R-013). A zero noncoulomb is exact (random evaluation can only lower the Cartan rank); every positive noncoulomb was recomputed with a second seed and doubled functionals (coulomb_recheck). Regenerated 2026-10-01 from the code/ module: all seven files identical, 1558 sectors. The method agrees with the independent eigenvalue-meson count of fortuity.bmn.gravindex on all 41 SU(3) sectors with Coulomb gravitons up to j = 14 (code/tests/test_noncoulomb.py).
caveat: coverage: SU(3), SU(4) j<=30; SO(5) j<=28; SO(7) j=20..26; Sp(3) j=20..24. Classical Q.; SO(11)/USp(10): only the R-011 columns at j = 26, GEN_NMAX = 12
